name: Paid Remote VFX Preproduction & Shoot-Prep Advisory by objekts
serviceType: Project-scoped paid remote visual-effects preproduction consulting before principal photography
description: Shot-level preproduction analysis for film, episodic, commercial and mixed-media productions. Assess planned visual effects against practical/on-set, 3D CGI, compositing, controlled generative AI and hybrid methods. Review optical and production feasibility; identify critical tests and deliver shot-specific camera, lens, tracking, lighting, clean-plate, reference and metadata capture instructions for the appointed crew and VFX team.
